name: Demon Ark
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: A demonic presence animates the ship carrying demon pirates.
disable: DC 23 Religion check (trained) to ward against demonic presence, DC 23 Arcana check (trained) or DC 23 Occultism check (trained) to weaken the demonic possession, DC 23 Intimidation check (trained) to scare it away, or DC 21 Sailing-lore check (trained) to confuse it; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine:
The demon ark uses its actions on one of the following options (GM's choice). It loses one action from its routine if a PC succeeds at an attempt to Disable it or it reaches its Broken Threshold.

  • Broadside Blast The demon ark makes a Chthonian cannon Strike.
  • Demonic List Effect The ship tosses and turns. Each creature in the hazard's area must make a DC 22 Reflex save. On a failure, it is knocked Prone; on a critical failure it also takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage.
  • Heads Will Roll It makes a bowsprit Strike.
  • Sea Chantey (auditory) All fiends within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects; all non-fiends within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

Effect: Sea Chantey

defensiveAbilities.name: No Prey, No Pay
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The demon ark hits another ship and Encounter A begins

Effect The demon ark fires grapples at the Snapdragon. Each PC must attempt a DC 22 Reflex save or be Grabbed (Escape); on a critical failure, they're also impaled and take 2d8+7 piercing damage. The demon ark then rolls initiative.
